4. 文字辨識(OCR):辨識說明與工具

針對套索辨識與整頁辨識的差異,以及近期 OCR 相關調整,整理如下。

① Multi Language 辨識中文不準 → 本週改名 Latin Language 本週處理

原因:Multi Language 實際上為拉丁語系(僅包含拉丁語系的種類),因此辨識中文時會不準確。本週先將名稱改為 Latin Language,避免誤會。

② 套索辨識準確度較整頁 OCR 低 待 HP 提供 .note

使用套索工具辨識的準確度,相較整頁 OCR 較低;此問題仍須等待 HP 提供 .note 檔,讓我們實際分析看看。

③ 繁體中文某些情況辨識成簡體 / 簡寫

繁體語言包本來就包含部分簡體(簡寫)字;因此若筆跡相像,辨識結果便會辨別到對應字體。(屬語言包特性說明)

④ 字母大小寫辨識不正確 待 HP 提供 .note

需請 HP 說明操作方式並提供 .note 檔,以協助我們分析。

OCR 工具列 icon 說明

下圖工具列中,剪刀與分享箭頭之間的三個 icon(紅 / 藍 / 綠框)功能如下:

外框功能
🔴 紅框(左)手寫筆跡辨識(純文字)。辨識後會跳出視窗詢問:插入(與墨跡共存)或取代(取代原墨跡)。
🔵 藍框(中)圖形辨識(混合辨識)。FluxInk 圖形辨識採混合辨識,可同時辨識圖形 / 數學公式 / 文字;本版已重修相關邏輯,改為依所選語言模型辨識,辨識後直接取代原有墨跡。
🟢 綠框(右)數學公式辨識。

2. This Build's Updates

aDraw fast handwriting layer

  • NEW　Fountain-pen algorithm is now connected: this build includes fountain-pen fast-handwriting-layer rendering.
  • Continues the brush pen (delivered in the 7/17 build), with thickness and solid-color settings.
  • UI for not-yet-supported pen types / colors is hidden in this build; the demo shows only completed items (see §5).

Camera / Gallery / media playback

  • Camera: after capture & confirm, go directly to Gallery; remove FPS display; remove related debug settings.
  • Gallery: video mode supports DU; video mode supports a white-background UI.
  • nMediaPlayer: fix the playback file name.

Architecture: remove Gallery from Tools

  • Remove Gallery from Tools; nImage and nMediaPlayer additionally search files under the Camera storage path.
Even with Gallery removed from Tools, our apps (nImage / nMediaPlayer) can still read media captured by the camera — no impact on the user experience.
Demo videos

3. Bug Fixes Fixed

  • PD charging (PD Driver) fix: align with IBP, 5V / 9V / 12V PD charging; finetune 9V charging stability.
Note: In DQA testing, charging with an HP laptop adapter reached 12V.

4. Text Recognition (OCR): Notes & Tools

Notes on the difference between lasso recognition and full-page recognition, plus recent OCR-related changes.

① Multi Language is inaccurate for Chinese → renamed to Latin Language this week done this week

Reason: "Multi Language" is actually the Latin family (it only contains Latin-family types), so recognizing Chinese is inaccurate. This week we rename it to "Latin Language" to avoid confusion.

② Lasso recognition is less accurate than full-page OCR need HP's .note

Recognition accuracy with the lasso tool is lower than full-page OCR; this still requires HP to provide a .note file so we can analyze it.

③ Traditional Chinese sometimes recognized as Simplified / variant forms

The Traditional Chinese language pack inherently contains some simplified (variant) characters; so when strokes are similar, recognition may land on the corresponding variant. (Language-pack characteristic.)

④ Upper/lower-case recognition is incorrect need HP's .note

Please have HP describe the operation and provide a .note file to help us analyze.

OCR toolbar icons

In the toolbar below, the three icons between the scissors and the share arrow (red / blue / green frames) are:

FrameFunction
🔴 Red (left)Handwriting (text) recognition. After recognition a dialog asks: Insert (coexist with ink) or Replace (replace the ink).
🔵 Blue (middle)Shape recognition (hybrid). FluxInk shape recognition is hybrid — it recognizes shapes / math formulas / text at once; this build reworks the logic to recognize per the selected language model, and the result directly replaces the original ink.
🟢 Green (right)Math-formula recognition.

5. Known Issues / Pending & Need HP's Help

  • Handwriting-layer pen-type progress: fountain pen is connected in this build; remaining pen types and non-pure colors are in progress (other pens est. ~8/28).
  • Lasso recognition accuracy: lower than full-page OCR, pending HP's .note file for analysis.
  • Upper/lower-case recognition: pending HP's operation notes and a .note file.
  • Traditional / Simplified: a characteristic of the Traditional pack containing variant chars (see §4-③).
